AIFIELD / DESIGN & SIMULATION

Shape the design. Inspect the physics.

AIFIELD is a photonic CAD and simulation project. Its September 2026 material describes an engineering environment for setting up designs and investigating their behavior through classical simulation.

An engineering workflow
01
Define

Describe the engineering question and relevant geometry.

02
Configure

Set up layers, process information and simulation conditions.

03
Simulate

Apply the appropriate classical calculation to the design.

04
Inspect

Review results, assumptions and comparison evidence before iterating.

What the supplied snapshot describes
Area	Described work	Review boundary
Design setup	Geometry, layers and process handling	Exact supported formats need confirmation
Optical simulation	Mode, circuit and field work	Scope and solver conditions vary by task
Thermal simulation	Investigation of thermal behavior	Current implementation coverage needs review
Results	Internal comparisons and worked designs	No fabricated-device measurement implied
A sensing question becomes a design

The photonic glucose chip-design example connects a measurement objective to optical design and simulation. The engineering output belongs to the tool’s evidence record. Whether a physical system can deliver the intended measurement is a separate ArtiSense question.

Examples & validation
A demo with a defined scope

A useful evaluation starts with your engineering task, expected inputs and the result you need to inspect. Current access, supported formats and demonstrable functions must be agreed with the project team; no downloadable release or open account service is offered here.
